cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I crossed out two o'clock like you and rewrote the invitation for three. That's my part of the empty meeting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My cross meant I couldn't attend at two. I didn't change the meeting time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, checking availability. I should have sent that revised invitation. What did you do with the room booking?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moved it upstairs. The ground-floor room had a leak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I've admitted the unsent invitation. Add your upstairs move to it, and we can send one explanation with both our names.

reason: Make A's partial admission consistently an unsent revised invitation instead of oscillating among told-everyone, poor update and late message.
